license_note: The repository ships a zero-byte LICENSE placeholder beside the governing nvidia-community-model-license-aug2024.pdf, while the card front matter names the different NVIDIA Open Model License and the trial page cites the older NVIDIA AI Foundation Models Community License Agreement. The in-repo August 2024 PDF governs, with a revocable grant and a production gate on NVIDIA NIM runtimes, and the conflicting pointers open a durable license review incident.
